regional_official_pdf.notes: Verified individual printed train/station cells, not a full timetable. R11 selects full-stop R trains in the outbound direction; R16 selects 8 directly labelled outbound trains. Dashes and non-running cells are excluded, never interpolated. Calendars use printed weekday/weekend for R11; R16 daily rows are subject to timetable footnotes and service notices. R15 includes only explicitly R15-labelled outbound train rows with directly printed calls; service calendar highlights and road replacement segments must be verified separately before asserting complete day-specific operation. R13 records are deliberately cut at Les Borges Blanques, current rail service limit; the published full timetable continues through a road-replacement corridor. R14 15051 is weekday-only and is cut at La Plana-Picamoixons, current rail-only service limit. This reference does not establish complete end-to-end railway itineraries.
